info.title: DentaBill API
info.description: Internal REST API for the DentaBill dashboard and CSV ingestion. Generated from Zod schemas — see ADR-017.

get.description: Readiness probe — server is ready to handle traffic. Tests Postgres and Redis readiness with 800ms timeout each.
Returns the authenticated DentaBill User and Organization for the current Clerk session.

patch.description: Update the current organization. Restricted to OWNER + ADMIN. NPI is required for payer dialling — empty values are accepted but block the Call Now action.

post.description: First-run onboarding for a Clerk-authenticated user. Idempotently creates the DentaBill Organization + User and stamps Clerk publicMetadata.
Create a claim under the authenticated user's organization.

get.description: List claims for the authenticated organization with cursor pagination, sortable by createdAt / serviceDate / priority / status, and filterable by status / payer / service-date range / claimNumber search.
Fetch a single claim by id, scoped to the auth organization.

patch.description: Patch a claim. Only fields supplied in the body are updated.

delete.description: Delete a claim. Hard-delete; soft-delete arrives in Phase 4.

post.description: Enqueue an outbound payer call for the given claim. Returns 202 with the BullMQ job id; the call lifecycle plays out in the call-worker.

get.description: List calls for the authenticated organization with cursor pagination, filterable by status / payer / startedAt range. Sorted by `startedAt` desc with id tiebreaker.
Aggregate call/claim metrics for the dashboard overview tiles. Org-scoped: only the authenticated tenant's rows contribute.
Fetch a single call with embedded CallEvent[] (timestamp asc) and a Claim summary. Cross-org access returns a uniform 404.

post.description: Cancel an in-flight call. Idempotent — re-cancellation of a terminal call is a 200 no-op. Phase 3 cancellation is soft: it stamps Call.dlqReason = CANCELLED_BY_OPERATOR + flips Claim → MANUAL_REVIEW; the live Retell call continues until natural termination (true mid-call cancel lands in Phase 4 once the worker bridges a cancel channel).

get.description: Fetch the structured CallSummary for a Call, if one exists. Returns 404 when the Call is not found in the caller’s org OR no summary has been persisted yet (the dashboard polls for both states with the same handler).

post.description: OWNER/ADMIN-gated retry of summary generation for a Call. Re-enqueues a `summary.generate` job onto the summaries queue. Idempotent on the BullMQ side — the jobId is `call.<id>.retry.<n>` derived from existing audit history.

get.description: Live call event stream (Server-Sent Events). Replays persisted CallEvent rows on connect, then streams new events via Redis pub/sub. Heartbeat every 15s; closes on server shutdown or auth expiry. See ADR-046.

post.description: Upload a CSV export from Dentrix, Eaglesoft, or Open Dental for the authenticated organization. Returns a parse summary; bulk DB insert lands in T48.

get.description: Aggregate billing usage for the calling org: current-month total + last 90 days of usage records (most recent first). Filters by organizationId via getOrgScopedDb so cross-org reads cannot leak.

post.description: Return a Stripe Customer Portal session URL. OWNER/ADMIN only. Phase 4 returns a stub URL when STRIPE_API_KEY is unset (test/dev); production wires the real Stripe SDK call.

Stripe webhook receiver. HMAC-verified. Phase 4 ships verification + replay-protection; live event routing lands in 4.5. Operates on request.rawBody captured by registerRawBodyPlugin so signature checks see byte-exact payload.

get.description: Aggregate metrics for the dashboard overview: recovered claims by week, denial reasons, claim aging, payer outcomes, and call volume.
List audit logs for the authenticated organization with cursor pagination. Sorted by `createdAt` desc with id tiebreaker.
